ledger.x: late spring 409: Gerontius rebels against Constantine III and appoints Maximus emperor.
early 411: Gerontius's army takes Gaul from Constantine III.
later 411: the Gaul Gerontius held returns to Honorius.

c. 411-412: Gerontius dies and Maximus flees. Gerontius 'defeat[ed] Constantine's forces and kill[ed] Constans at Vienna' in 411, 'but Gerontius later deserts to Constantius, retires to Hispania, and kills himself'; 'Maximus loses his main supporter and flees to sanctuary "amongst the barbarians in Hispania"'; Prosper…

wars.name: Revolt of Gerontius and Maximus against Constantine III
wars.outcome: Gerontius 'successfully besieged and captured Constans' at Vienne in 411 and executed him, but his troops deserted him and he killed himself; Maximus fled to the barbarians in Hispania.

certainty.note: The pages name Hispania and two cities (Tarraco, Barcino); no boundary.
